name: ai21-empty-placeholder
purpose: convertAI21Messages' empty arm (prompt-converters.js:631-669, placeholder at :663-665): an EMPTY messages array becomes one user turn carrying PROMPT_PLACEHOLDER, the module-load value of 'promptPlaceholder' (:4) left at its pinned default here. DISCRIMINATING BECAUSE: this request carries NO json_schema, so the pre-converter push at chat-completions.js:816-825 does not run and the array really is empty when the converter sees it; the recorded body must therefore contain exactly that one user turn, which no other ai21 scenario can produce.
stage1Boundary: Stage 1 validates the backend -> provider transformation only. Browser-side prompt assembly happens in the frontend before the request reaches the route and is NOT covered here; a green provider-wire capture is not evidence of preset-level equivalence.

tier2.rule: compared as "Bearer <redacted>"; the planted value is verified by expectedAuthorizationKey
tier2.reason: a credential is not a contract
AI21 has no reverse_proxy and no custom_url: API_AI21 + /chat/completions is the only URL the branch can build

tier3.reason: It is a measurement of elapsed wall-clock time, so it differs on every run and no backend can match it; the value is a duration, not a contract.
